scope: Excel AH identity, class market caps, independent live checker

requests.table: Two BDP CURRENT_MARKET_CAP_SHARE_CLASS fields per pair, gated by AH E4 Bloomberg; pricing currencies CNY and HKD; field default millions. No stored cap snapshots exist.
requests.checker: Always-live scalar LAST_PRICE for the numeric M60 H code and resolved/overridden A code; reuse existing Market Data quotes/FX only when E4 is Bloomberg. No BDH added.

capitalization_basis: Share-class field RR233, not issuer-wide CUR_MKT_CAP. Public Bloomberg methodology defines CUR_MKT_CAP as company-wide. Actual RR233 coverage, units and entitlement must be checked on an entitled terminal; no terminal claim is made.

sources.use: Official definition of company-wide CUR_MKT_CAP; does not verify live RR233 responses.

data_changes: None; all saved prices, histories, financials, IPO terms and HTML unchanged.
publication: Local deliverable only. New-session publication authorization not yet given.
request_failure_display: Text BBG unavailable for the checker; Unavailable for cap fields; never zero. Source fixture tests cannot certify terminal entitlement or response semantics.
layout: A:L roster; multiline headers with room for filter buttons; three identifier columns frozen; chart panels M:R; M60 code preserved; 18 original premium notes and VML anchors relocated to H:I.
